provenance: Set a URL ONLY after it is live and has been opened in a browser, and set `verified` to the date it was checked. Until then the README renders an explicit not-deployed marker rather than a link, because README.md previously read 'Live at the URL above' with no URL above it -- a claim with nothing behind it, which is the shape this project treats as worse than an absent badge. dbt_docs_url is published by the `pages` job in .github/workflows/ci.yml; it will be https://<owner>.github.io/<repo>/ once Pages is enabled for this repository, and note that Pages on a PRIVATE repo needs a paid GitHub plan.
